newsitem.title: USA: Grand Union sees Q1 EBITDA below last year.
newsitem.headline: Grand Union sees Q1 EBITDA below last year.

text.p: The Grand Union Co said Thursday it expects first quarter 1998 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization to be significantly lower than the first quarter a year ago.
The restaurant company said the first quarter 1998 does not include the busy Easter period, as it did a year ago.
Further, the company said operations continue to be hampered by strong competition in the New York metropolitan area.
Earnings will also be affected by the company's continuing pattern of high promotional spending, the company said.
